name: filter-toolbar
description: The controls above a list or `DataGrid`, composed from parts that are each controlled (`value`/`onChange`), so every filter maps to a search param. `FilterToolbar` lays them out (wrapping on narrow screens) and its `i18n.labels` reaches every part. `FilterSearch` is a react-aria `SearchField` that commits the term on Enter and when cleared — and, with `debounceMs`, after the user stops typing. `FilterQuickToggles` is an outlined `ToggleGroup` for one-press filters. `FilterToolbarActions` holds the trailing actions: `FilterSheet` (a "Filters" button with the active count opening a side `Sheet`; its children are the `Field`s of a draft the app keeps, `onApply` commits it — return `false` to stay open — `onClear` empties it, and Enter applies) and `FilterRefresh` (spins while `isPending`). `FilterChips` shows the applied filters as a react-aria `TagGroup`, each removable with its × or Backspace/Delete, plus "Clear filters"; it renders nothing when empty.
